name: NeuSG
definition: A method that incorporates the NeRF-based surface reconstruction method NeuS into the 3DGS representation to transfer surface properties to 3DGS.
summary: NeuSG integrates NeuS implicit surface reconstruction into 3D Gaussian Splatting to directly couple a Signed Distance Function with a Gaussian rasterizer, ensuring explicit surface properties without relying on monocular depth priors or post-hoc mesh extraction.
